landing.title: Paste the Job Description. Get the profiles you need.
landing.subtitle: AI-Hunting reads the JD, finds public LinkedIn profiles that fit and hands them to you ranked by match, with the outreach message ready.
landing.step1Body: Text, PDF, Word or a screenshot. AI extracts seniority, skills and location.
landing.step2Body: We track down matching public profiles and drop duplicates.
landing.step3Body: 20 to 30 profiles with a match score, reasons and a personalized message.
landing.footnote: AI-Hunting never logs into your LinkedIn account or sends messages on your behalf.

auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to continue with your hunts.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a link to {email} to confirm your account. If you don't see it, check spam.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: You haven't confirmed your email yet. Check your inbox.
errors.weakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.userExists: An account with that email already exists.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.callback: We couldn't complete the sign-in. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

dashboard.subtitle: All your talent searches in one place.
dashboard.emptyTitle: You haven't run any hunts yet
dashboard.emptyBody: Upload a Job Description and we'll return 20 to 30 profiles ranked by match.
dashboard.quotaNone: You used all {total} hunts for today. They reset at 00:00 UTC.

newHunt.title: New hunt
newHunt.subtitle: Paste the Job Description or upload the file. We do the rest.
newHunt.dropHint: or drop a file: PDF, Word (.docx), TXT or a screenshot (PNG, JPG). Up to 4 MB.
newHunt.dropActive: Drop it to load the JD
newHunt.placeholder: E.g.: We are looking for a Senior QA Automation engineer with Cypress or Playwright experience, intermediate English, for a team in Buenos Aires…
newHunt.privacy: Don't include confidential client data in the JD.

errors.JD_TOO_SHORT: The JD is too short. Paste the full description (at least 200 characters).
errors.JD_TOO_LONG: The JD is too long (30,000 characters max).
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 4 MB. Try a lighter PDF or paste the text.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE: That file type can't be read. Use PDF, Word (.docx), TXT or an image.
errors.JD_UNREADABLE: We couldn't read any text in the file. Try pasting the JD text.
errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: Reading images and scanned PDFs isn't active yet. Paste the text or upload a PDF/Word with text.
errors.DAILY_LIMIT: You reached today's hunt limit. It resets at 00:00 UTC.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session expired. Please log in again.
errors.AI_LIMIT: You used today's AI readings (images and scanned PDFs). Paste the text or upload a PDF/Word with text.
errors.AI_BUSY: The AI is busy right now. Try again in a few minutes or paste the JD text.

hunt.progressHint: This takes 1 to 2 minutes. You can stay here: the page updates on its own.
hunt.pendingRunBody: This hunt hasn't searched for profiles yet.
hunt.staleBody: The search was interrupted. You can restart it without using your daily quota.
hunt.booleanHint: Paste it in LinkedIn or LinkedIn Recruiter search to keep looking.

errors.AI_BUSY: The AI is busy right now and we couldn't finish the search. Try creating the hunt again in a few minutes.
errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The AI isn't configured in the app yet.
errors.SEARCH_BUSY: The search engine didn't respond. Try creating the hunt again in a few minutes.
errors.SEARCH_NOT_CONFIGURED: The search engine isn't configured in the app yet.
errors.SEARCH_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: The app's free monthly search quota is used up. It resets on the 1st.
errors.NO_RESULTS: We couldn't find public profiles for this JD. Try another country or use the boolean string on LinkedIn.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong during the search. Try creating the hunt again.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this page
notFound.body: The link may be mistyped, or the hunt may no longer exist.
